C80.justification: The endpoint checks only public word/anchor/submission constraints and planted stylistic proxies. There is no semantic plot checker or human preference annotation. Shuffling targets therefore challenges pairing while leaving unmeasured whether a generated story actually fits its assigned plot.

C81.justification: The schedule is max(3, ceil(30/ceil(N/16))) epochs with N equal to 14, 55, or 460. This gives 30/8/3 epochs and 30/32/87 optimizer steps. SFT additionally conditions on the original trajectory prefix. Learning-rate selection used only seed 31 at 60 opportunities. Hence the recipe contrast is not an isolated causal manipulation of storage representation.
